anna: Quick flag ew runs of rk7b-int4 on anchor_core_plus_tail show NDCG@10 delta ~ -0.035 vs fp16, MRR@1 flat. Anyone seen similar?
jorge: saw a small dip in my smoke when I ran the ptq build. Which dataset split and metric were you using?
anna: holdout=anchor_core_plus_tail.sample(10k), metric=ndcg@10, seeds=[0,1,2]. CI bootstrap (query-level) gave median -0.035, 95% CI [-0.049, -0.021], p~0.004.
emily: MRR flat but ndcg drop suggests reordering within top10. Could be candidate-gen/topk mismatch or tokenization/concat differences.
rao: Also check quant config: was this per-channel symmetric int4 or asymmetric per-tensor? We had scale mismatch when switching to per-channel for 4bit.
anna: PTQ config shows: quant_bits=4, scheme=per_channel_symmetric, clip=0.995. Build used tokenizer 0.15.1 (same as prod).
jorge: Good tokenizer parity. Next probes: (1) force topk=10 candidate-gen parity, (2) run with `--log-candidates` to capture top-20 per query, (3) run `--batch-size 1 --kvpack=false` to remove packing heuristics.
diane: Also try a tiny embed-rescale (multiply embed vectors by 0.98/1.02) as a sensitivity ablation; earlier we saw scale shifts move tail ndcg.
anna: I'll kick off an ablation matrix: A: fp16 baseline, B: int4-as-is, C: int4 + batch/kv parity, D: int4 + candidate parity (topk=10), E: int4 + embed-rescale. Seeds [7,13,21].
ci-bot: CI: rerank-ablation queued job=6123 (int4-as-is), 6124 (int4-batch-kv-parity), 6125 (int4-candidate-parity), 6126 (int4-embed-rescale). Artifacts to s3://redwood-debug/rerank/1798880000/.
emily: For stats use cluster-bootstrap at query-cohort level, and also report per-slice ndcg (core vs tail vs rare-entity). Use effect size (Cohen's d) too.
rao: Add token-diff logging for any queries with ndcg delta > 0.02 so we can inspect tokenization + truncation differences.
jorge: Quick command I'll run for candidate parity (small split):
```
python -m eval.rerank --model rk7b-int4 --anchors anchor_core_plus_tail --topk 10 --log-candidates --metric ndcg@10 --seed 7 --batch-size 1 --kvpack false
```
anna: I'll run the embed-rescale sweep after those complete. If candidate parity removes most gap, we patch PTQ harness; if not, we may need to change int4 scheme or add per-dim bias correction.
diane: If embedding-scale tweak helps, it's a low-risk release fix: small global scale applied post-embedding before scoring. But prefer parity fixes first.
ci-bot: Update: job 6123 finished. Snapshot: ndcg10_delta=-0.036 (p=0.003). Artifacts: https://ci.internal/rerank/6123/artifacts.json
anna: baseline confirmed. Waiting on 6124/6125.
ci-bot: Update: job 6124 finished. int4 + batch/kv parity -> ndcg10_delta=-0.022 (p=0.032). Artifacts: s3://redwood-debug/rerank/1798880000/6124.json
jorge: Batch/kvpack explains part of it. Packing heuristics change effective token boundaries and can alter topk ordering.
ci-bot: Update: job 6125 finished. int4 + candidate parity -> ndcg10_delta=-0.006 (p=0.22). Logged candidate diffs for 142 failing queries to s3://redwood-debug/rerank/1798880000/candidate-diffs/
emily: Nice ix candidate-gen parity seems to recover most. That suggests churn in passage chunking/topk caused reordering.
anna: I'll open a PR to lock candidate-gen params in the PTQ eval harness and add an assertion that token counts per-candidate match fp16 runs. Tagging @jorge @rao for review.
diane: Still run the embed-rescale test for completeness. If there's residual variance we might add a tiny post-scale applied only to quant builds.
ci-bot: Update: job 6126 finished. int4 + embed-rescale(0.99) -> ndcg10_delta=-0.005 (p=0.28). No further improvement beyond candidate parity.
jorge: Action items: 1) Add candidate-gen parity gate to ptq CI (fail if topk/chunk/stride mismatch) 2) Pin batch-size/kvpack for eval 3) Persist candidate logs by default for rerank bring-up 4) Add token-count consistency assertion 5) Document quant scheme used in release notes.
anna: Will do PRs and link them here. Also will add a small doc on "eval parity checklist" for future model bring-ups so we don't chase tooling drift.
emily: Great triage. Summary: root cause = packaging of evaluations (kvpack/batching) + candidate-gen parity; quant scheme not primary.
ci-bot: Closing: jobs completed, artifacts at s3://redwood-debug/rerank/1798880000/. Please reply if you want raw logs zipped. :white_check_mark:
